scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @document-qa/api && npm run build --workspace @document-qa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @document-qa/contracts && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @document-qa/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @document-qa/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @document-qa/contracts && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts apps/web/src/components/*.test.ts apps/web/src/components/*.test.tsx
